thread:
carmen: Heads up — ran a bulk role import for Acme and noticed duplicate role-bindings created across tenants when using the `apply_template` column.
carmen: Repro steps: 1) CSV with template name `billing-basic` 2) Import via Console > Roles > Import CSV 3) importer API `POST /api/v1/roles/import` returns 200 but tenant B (not selected) now has duplicate bindings for BillingViewer.
li: that's scary. Can you paste a sample CSV row you used?
carmen: sure:
```
tenant_id,role_name,apply_template
tenant:acme,Billing Team,billing-basic
```
The template `billing-basic` exists globally and references a role ID (r_200) without scope. Importer seems to resolve by name globally and then create role_bindings scoped to the CSV tenant *and* also append to the global template target.
oscar: sounds like the importer is doing two things: resolving template -> role mapping and then calling the template apply path which is global-scoped. Bug is missing scope normalization when applying templates.
harper: consequence: duplicate binding rows in `role_bindings` table and doubled quotas for some routes for tenant B. Not good.
sre-bot: flagged: high-sev data-consistency (rule: cross-tenant mutation) — page on-call if not mitigated in 2 hours.
li: quick mitigation: disable CSV importer feature flag `bulkRoleImport` while we patch. Also add a DB constraint to prevent identical (principal, role_id, tenant) tuples being inserted concurrently.
oscar: for long-term fix: 1) importer must always normalize template resolution to the target tenant when CSV includes tenant_id; 2) if template is global-intent, importer should clone role into tenant scope instead of mutating a global template; 3) provide dry-run preview in UI with explicit list of bindings to be created.
carmen: UI ask: show a preview modal with diff: existing bindings vs to-be-created, and clearly mark any cross-tenant changes. Include checkboxes to opt-out of cloning globals.
harper: also emit telemetry `perm_import.duplicate_binding_attempt` with counts and `perm_import.clone_decision` tag. We should backfill alerts if rate > 5/min.
li: add audit log entries on import with `import.requester`, `import.csv_checksum`, and `import.preview_accepted` boolean. This helps SRE for rollback trace.
oscar: I'll open PR in services/importer: 1) add tenant-aware template resolution, 2) implement idempotent upsert to role_bindings (unique index + ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING), 3) add dry-run endpoint `POST /api/v1/roles/import?dry_run=true` returning preview payload, 4) emit telemetry and audit events.
carmen: ping for UI: console-devs add modal behind `showImportPreview` flag. Modal should include a small inline warning: "Importing a template that exists globally will create a tenant-scoped clone unless you choose otherwise."
harper: tests: unit for template resolution, integration test where same template name exists global + tenant-local, and an end-to-end with CSV that previously triggered duplication. Also add a migration to add unique constraint on role_bindings `(principal_id, role_id, tenant)` with a backfill script that dedupes safely.
li: good call. For backfill: dedupe by keeping the earliest created binding, add audit row for any deleted duplicates. Run backfill in low-traffic window.
oscar: PR will include small schema migration and backfill plan in description. Tag @li for review.
deploy-bot: deploy queued to staging (build #8810) - running importer tests.
carmen: once staged, I'll test: import CSV with 3 rows (tenant A use template, tenant B use same name) and verify no cross-tenant impact and preview modal lists cloning ops.
harper: after merge, add dashboard panel: `perm_import.*` and a KPI tile showing `duplicate_binding_count` and `import.preview_accept_rate`.
li: thanks. Also update runbook: if duplicates are detected, run backfill dedupe script and contact clients impacted with timeline.
oscar: I'll add docs for the importer UX and a short note in the release notes about cloning semantics.
carmen: thanks team.
